fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects command line patterns associated with the use of Pnscan for sending and receiving binary data across the network.
This behavior has been identified in a Linux malware campaign targeting Docker, Apache Hadoop, Redis, and Confluence and was previously used by the threat actor known as TeamTNT
fields.name: Pnscan Binary Data Transmission Activity
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and tgt.process.cmdline matches "-(W|R)\\s?(\\s|"|')([0-9a-fA-F]{2}\\s?){2,20}(\\s|"|')")
